citation: HL7 v2.3 Chapter 8, section 8.8.1 Patient location master file message (MFN/MFK), p 8-50. Structure ID MFN_M05 synthesised as CODE_EVT from the message code MFN and M05, the first event overrides.json eventsFromTitle gives it (v2.3 prints no structure ID and no Table 0354).
